summary: Backend-only iteration for Twilio caller-ID verification on trial account. Extended /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py with 3 new test classes (8 new tests): TestCallerVerification (verified-callers read + 5 parameterized invalid-phone 400 cases), TestReadiness (config shape), and TestVoiceSimulatorBudget (mock agent + budget object per turn). All 18 tests pass (~7s). Did NOT submit any well-formed E.164 to /api/voice/verify-caller (would place a billable real call). Only mock agent used for voice simulate turns (no paid OpenAI calls). Full REST vertical slice + idempotent submit + stale-after-edit + domain errors all still green.
critical_code_review_comments: gateway.verify_caller: on well-formed E.164 the endpoint will place a REAL billable Twilio call. Consider requiring an explicit ack flag (e.g. body.confirm=true) or an admin gate to prevent accidental billable calls from public POST. Not blocking; documented in this iteration.
seed_data_creation: None - tests create their own orders
context_for_next_testing_agent: 18-test pytest suite in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py runs in ~7s with 2 workers. Verified endpoints: GET /api/voice/verified-callers (twilio_credentials=true, verified=[]), POST /api/voice/verify-caller invalid-phone branch (400 invalid_phone) for 5 payloads. GET /api/voice/readiness confirms voice_provider=openai_realtime, openai_key_present=true, twilio_configured=false, twilio_budget_usd=10.0, public_base_url set. Mock-agent simulate exposes {estimated_cost_usd,cap_usd,exceeded} in every turn's 'budget' field. AVOID posting real E.164 numbers to /verify-caller (real call).
